onb.title: Set up your company account
onb.lead: Tell us about your business. A person at Setu reviews every company before the account is activated.
onb.notice: All money movement in Setu is Simulated: no real funds are moved. A person reviews every company before activation, so this can take some time.
onb.reviewNote: Check your details. After you submit, a person reviews your company. You can sign in again at any time to see the status.

h.displayName: The person who will use this account.
h.licenseName: Only if it differs from the legal name.
h.taxId: A Bangladesh buyer needs a TIN of 9 to 13 digits.
h.accountNumber: 8 to 34 letters or digits, no spaces.
h.holderName: Must match the company's legal name. A mismatch sends your application to a closer review.

v.tin: A Bangladesh buyer's TIN must be 9 to 13 digits.
v.iso2: Use a 2-letter country code, for example BD.
v.account: Use 8 to 34 letters or digits, no spaces.
v.simAccount: Demo (SIM-) account numbers cannot be used for a real account.
v.server: The server did not accept this value. Please check it.

err.ONBOARDING_EXISTS: You have already submitted this application.
err.EMAIL_IN_USE: This email already belongs to another Setu account.
err.COUNTRY_NOT_SUPPORTED: Setu does not support companies in that country yet.
err.LICENSE_EXISTS: A company with this licence number is already registered.

st.title: Your application
st.loadFailed: We could not load your status. Please try again.

pending.title: Waiting for review
pending.body: A person at Setu is reviewing your company. You can leave this page; it checks for updates by itself and takes you into the app once you are approved.

approved.title: Approved
approved.body: Your company is approved. Taking you into Setu...

st.activateFailed: You are approved, but we could not open your session. Please try again.
st.polling: This page refreshes about every 20 seconds while it is open.

rejected.title: Application not approved
rejected.noReason: No reason was recorded. Please contact support.

onb.title: Company onboarding review
onb.intro: Review new companies before they can use Setu. A decision is final.
onb.adminOnly: Only an administrator can review company applications.
onb.approveBody: {name} will be activated and its bank account enabled. This cannot be undone.
onb.rejectBody: {name} will be suspended and shown your reason. This cannot be undone.
onb.reasonHint: At least {min} characters. The applicant can read it.

err.ONBOARDING_DECIDED: This application was already decided. The list has been refreshed.
err.SELF_DECISION: You cannot decide your own application.

team.title: Team
team.intro: People who can sign in for your company. Owners manage the team.
team.noEmail: No email is sent. Ask the person to register with this exact email address; their account links the first time they sign in with it verified.
team.invited: {email} was added. They can now register with this address.
team.removeBody: {name} ({email}) will lose access to your company's account.
team.noParty: This account is not linked to a company, so it has no team.

roleHelp.OWNER: Can manage the team and everything else.
roleHelp.FINANCE: Can work with deals and payments.
roleHelp.VIEWER: Can only look; cannot change anything.

err.EMAIL_IN_USE: This email already belongs to a Setu account.
err.PARTY_NOT_VERIFIED: Your company must be approved before you can add members.
err.LAST_OWNER: A company needs at least one owner. Make someone else an owner first.

dealErr.VIEWER_READ_ONLY: Your role is read-only, so you cannot make changes. Ask a company owner.
dealErr.ACCOUNT_NOT_ONBOARDED: Finish setting up your company account first.
dealErr.ACCOUNT_PENDING: Your account is still waiting for review.
